# Lane 2.62: browser tests for the demo cut

| Clause                                                        | Proven by                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| A. a scorekeeper signs in, opens a game and scores it         | live-game, scoring-screen, scoring-plays, score-this-game, first-test-walk     |
| A. a second screen shows each play within 2 seconds, measured | live-game (one play); NEW game-night (each of nine plays)                      |
| A. a second scorekeeper takes over                            | scoring-trouble (on the scoring screen); NEW game-night (in the same walk)     |
| A. the game ends; standings and totals move                   | first-test-walk, overtime; NEW game-night (after the takeover, in one walk)    |
| B. a final score entered and published                        | games-area, first-test-walk, needs-result                                      |
| B. a forfeit                                                  | ask-first                                                                      |
| B. a correction                                               | games-area, corrected-mark                                                     |
| B. a schedule change published                                | reschedule, publish-preview                                                    |
| C. public pages as a visitor, hidden numbers (demo-shaped)    | demo-league-on-database; NEW demo-hidden-numbers (every page, games too)       |
| C. public pages as staff, hidden numbers (demo-shaped)        | staff-numbers (seed league, three pages); NEW demo-hidden-numbers (every page) |
| C. accessibility on every new screen (T-186)                  | each test above; the new tests on every screen they open (once per page kind)  |

What I wrote: `tests/browser/game-night-test.mjs` (19 checks, stand-in) and `tests/browser/demo-hidden-numbers-test.mjs` (222 checks: 5 list pages, 24 school pages, 11 game pages, each as a visitor and as the owner; the page as the server sent it to either names no hidden player, the visitor is shown none, the owner is shown them on the statistics page and the five schools' pages). Each passed six times in a row here; no product code changed, no product fault found.

Decided (Agreed (delegated), technical): A runs on the stand-in, not the demo-shaped league. That league's 120 games are all final, and the made-up database has no live service yet (`database-ports.ts`: `liveFeed: null`), so a watcher there sees a play only by the 5-second snapshot: within 2 seconds cannot hold there today. B stays proven on the stand-in by the tests named. Accessibility is checked once per kind of page for each of the two people, not on all 40 pages (time).

Distrust: game-night's tablets score through the tracker's endpoints, not by taps on the scoring screen (scoring-plays does the taps); "signs in" is the stand-in's session cookie. The statistics "move" is checked as "not what they were", not number by number. The second-screen times (11 to 36 ms) are on one computer with no network between. Not run here: `npm run verify`, the whole browser chain.

## Review

- Medium: the forfeit is only half proven: `ask-first-test.mjs:538-593` and `later-games-test.mjs:185-208` record one in the admin, but no test then reads it published (the public game page saying who forfeited, the standings counting it). The correction (`corrected-mark`), the schedule change (`reschedule`) and the final score (`first-test-walk`, game 2 typed in Games, read by a visitor) are proven as the step words them; `games-area` and `needs-result` read only the admin.
- Medium: no test anywhere taps the scoring screen while timing a second screen: `game-night-test.mjs:93-136` and `live-game-test.mjs:6` both score through the endpoints. Small fix: the scorekeeper's plays by taps on the scoring screen (as `scoring-screen` does), timed from the tap.
- Medium: "the statistics move" is `text !== statsBefore` (`game-night-test.mjs:326`): any change passes. Compare numbers counted from the plays (Hawks' first player 3 points, Hawks 10, Bears 7).
- Medium: `demo-hidden-numbers-test.mjs:205-215` proves the owner is shown hidden numbers on the statistics and school pages only, though staff are shown them on game pages too (`staff-game-numbers.tsx`): on the 11 game pages nothing proves the check could see a name. Add the owner's check on the tracked school's game pages.
- Medium: part A never runs on the demo-shaped league. The live service on the database is planned by open steps 2.124 and 2.116 (`database-ports.ts:343-346`), but 2.116's done test names the stand-in and the staging-shaped adapter only: the lead should add "the demo-shaped league, within 2 seconds" to it.
- Low: the 2-second timing is real (from before the send to `data-live-sequence`, drawn in the same render as the score, `live-game-view.tsx:255`) and 3 seconds would fail (`game-night-test.mjs:266`), but it does not read the play's words on the screen.
- Low: "Final, 10 to 7" is `includes('10') && includes('7')` (`game-night-test.mjs:290`); read the scoreboard's two scores.
- Low: the takeover is by the owner, not a second scorekeeper, and the first tablet's refusal passes on any error (`game-night-test.mjs:247`); check the refusal's own answer.
- Low: hidden players are matched only as "First L." (`demo-hidden-numbers-test.mjs:55`); a full name passes. The stats `?by=` and `?season=` views and the game's public snapshot answer are not read. Otherwise all seven public routes under `app/[league]/(site)` are opened (`my` is not public), the server's raw page is read (`:168`), no league is named in code.
- Low: accessibility once per kind of page per person, not on every page (decided above; acceptable for time).
